summary: Cre8 Enterprise Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its wholly owned subsidiary, Cre8 Incorporation Limited, closed on November 2, 2026 the acquisition of 100% of Hong Kong-based Lingxpert Language Services Limited from sole shareholder Ms. Sze Yan Chrystal Lau for US$800,000 cash, funded from existing cash; the SPA was signed October 19, 2026. The board and audit committee approved, with disclosure of the seller's personal relationship to Mr. Jordan Lee, a related party through controlling shareholder Cre8 Investments. Indemnities survive 12 months, except fraud and title claims. Watch related-party optics and integration of a prior affiliate vendor.
